headline: Nvidia released its 30-billion-parameter Nemotron 3.5 Lightning model on 11 Aug 2026, and The Information reported then that a Nemotron 4 above one trillion parameters is in development.
score_reason: Pool 6 lowered by 2: both the Nemotron 3.5 Lightning release and The Information's Nemotron 4 report date from 11 Aug 2026, so this is older news re-dated; Nemotron 4 is an unconfirmed report.
importance_line: Companies and developers who want an open AI model that runs well on Nvidia chips may get a much larger option one day, but Nemotron 4 is an unconfirmed report with no release date and this story is two months old.
summary: Stocktwits, citing The Information, reports that Nvidia, which released the agent-focused Nemotron 3.5 Lightning model (about 30 billion parameters, the adjustable settings that make up an AI model) on 11 Aug 2026, is building Nemotron 4, expected to exceed 1 trillion parameters and so roughly twice the size of its current largest model, Nemotron 3 Ultra. No release date is set and two people familiar with the project say it could arrive as soon as this fall, while the report notes that so large a model could put Nvidia in competition with customers such as OpenAI and Microsoft.
notes: Older news re-dated: the 11 Aug 2026 story resurfaced in feeds on 11 Oct 2026. Read Stocktwits in full; The Information's own article is paywalled and was not opened.
